release_notes:
v1.0.27+34 - Dedicated Guest Catalog Hub, Robust Null Safety & Zero Emoji Polish
- Resolved White/Grey Blank Card Exception: Hardened Public Catalog card renderer with complete null-coalescing fallbacks for dynamic video tutorial items (e.g. yuyuyuyuyu) with graceful thumbnail and gradient fallback.
- Dedicated Guest Feeding Channel: On-demand song tutorials and masterclasses directly exposed under public guest catalog with time-rated access.
- Streamlined Landing Page Action: Simplified the guest launch action to a clean, robust, and un-obnoxious 'Guest' button.
- 100% Emoji Eradication: Purged all legacy emojis across buttons, badges, categories, and snackbars in favor of clean Material Icons.
